ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Voice control fits my Fire TV setup, but I would pass on adding a speaker this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa interests me, but a standalone speaker is not a strong enough need right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A compact smart display could suit my connected home, but I would check camera compatibility before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so another HD stick adds little.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my video equipment, but I would only buy it when I need another cable or a longer connection.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add simple on-off control for a lamp alongside my existing connected devices.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The display interests me for home use, but I do not currently have a clear need for another screen.
ItemID: NA; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Storage and file transfer could help with my Canon camcorder, but I would verify the card specifications first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo (4th Gen) | Glacier White with Sengled Bluetooth Color bulb | Alexa smart home starter kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Lighting control appeals to me, but I would start with the smart plug before buying a speaker-and-bulb bundle.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing 4K stick already covers streaming, and the themed cover gives me no practical reason to replace it.
